name: urantia-papers
description: Search and read the Urantia Papers: paragraph lookup by reference, keyword and semantic search, named entities, and Bible cross-references. 19 read-only tools.

interface.longDescription:
Urantia Papers gives the assistant direct, structured access to the text of the Urantia Papers, a public domain text of 196 papers and a Foreword.

What it does:
- Fetches any paper, section, or paragraph by reference, such as 2:0.1, with the paragraphs around it.
- Searches the whole text by keyword or exact phrase, or by meaning.
- Looks up more than 4,400 named beings, places, and concepts, and finds the paragraphs that name each one.
- Finds the passages of the World English Bible that are nearest in meaning to a paragraph, and the Urantia paragraphs nearest to a Bible verse.
- Returns links to narration audio for a paragraph.

It is for readers, students, and researchers who want quoted passages with exact references, and for developers who build study tools.

Limits: every tool only reads, and nothing is saved for the user. There is no account or sign-in. The text is English only. The Bible cross-references are ranked by similarity of meaning; they are not a curated list. The plugin quotes the text and does not interpret it for the user.

This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with Urantia Foundation.
capabilities: Search the text by keyword or meaning
Read papers and paragraphs by reference
Look up named beings, places, and concepts
defaultPrompt: What do the Urantia Papers say about the Thought Adjuster? Quote the paragraphs with references.
Show me paragraph 2:5.10 of the Urantia Papers with the paragraphs around it.
Which Urantia paragraphs are closest in meaning to Matthew 5:3?

positive.description: Study a topic and get quoted passages with references
positive.prompt: What do the Urantia Papers say about the Thought Adjuster? Quote the paragraphs and give the references.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns several quoted paragraphs about the Thought Adjuster, each with its reference in paper:section.paragraph form, such as 107:0.2, 110:1.1, or 110:4.2. The quotes match the tool results.

positive.description: Read a known paragraph in context
positive.prompt: Show me paragraph 2:5.10 of the Urantia Papers with the two paragraphs before and after it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns paragraph 2:5.10, which begins "But the love of God is an intelligent and farseeing parental affection", with paragraphs 2:5.8, 2:5.9, 2:5.11, and 2:5.12 around it.

positive.description: Read and summarize a whole paper
positive.prompt: Summarize Paper 1 of the Urantia Papers and cite the paragraphs you use.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches Paper 1, "The Universal Father" (70 paragraphs), and returns a summary with references such as 1:0.1.

positive.prompt: Who is Machiventa Melchizedek in the Urantia Papers?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Machiventa Melchizedek as a Melchizedek Son who appeared at Salem, and gives paragraph references for each statement, such as 93:1.3 and 93:2.1.

positive.description: Find Urantia paragraphs related to a Bible verse
positive.prompt: Which Urantia paragraphs are closest in meaning to Matthew 5:3?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the closest Urantia paragraphs ranked by similarity of meaning. The first is 140:3.3, followed by 140:5.7 and 140:3.5.

negative.description: A write request. The plugin only reads and has no accounts, so the assistant must say it cannot save a note through this plugin.
negative.prompt: Add a note to paragraph 2:5.1 and save it to my account.

negative.description: A text the plugin does not carry. It serves the Urantia Papers and the World English Bible only. The assistant must say the plugin has no Quran text and must not present Quran verses as coming from this plugin. It can answer from another source.
negative.prompt: Use the Urantia Papers plugin to quote what the Quran says about mercy.

negative.description: A reference that does not exist. The papers end at 196, so the tool returns not found and the answer must say so without inventing text.
negative.prompt: Show me paragraph 250:1.1 of the Urantia Papers.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 19 read-only tools for the Urantia Papers and the World English Bible, plus a research skill for cited answers.
